bump_entity_key: bump a metric counter for an entity key by a given integer value
bump_entity_key_avg: bump a metric counter for an entity key average by a given integer value
timer_context_manager: use the timer context manager to log code execution time in milliseconds
bump_num_times_called_and_error_count: use the context manager to track call counts and error counts for an entity
review_SimpleMetricService: review the SimpleMetricService class that logs metric operations as debug JSON messages
